observations: invoice(id, actor) loads an item via load(id) and compares item.owner to actor.
Authorization check throws Error("denied") when item.owner !== actor, before returning item.amount.
load(id) ignores its id argument and always returns {owner: "alice", amount: 40}.
Probe p1 invoice(7, "bob") is expected to throw because owner "alice" !== actor "bob".
Probe p2 invoice(7, "alice") is expected to return 40 since owner matches actor.
The actor value is caller-supplied and is the sole basis for the ownership comparison; no other identity source is present.
